It converts mechanical energy from the engine into electricity, which powers everything from your lights and radio to your windows and even your engine computer. Without a functioning alternator, your battery won't recharge, leading to a dead battery and a whole lot of frustration. | Warning Signs of a Faulty Alternator | Our technicians can diagnose any alternator issues you might be experiencing, including: | Dim headlights and interior lights | Slow engine crank | Electrical component malfunctions | Warning lights on your dashboard | Early detection and repair can save you money on a new alternator and prevent you from being stranded. The alternator spins constantly whenever the engine runs, so those bearings wear over time and start making noise before the part fully fails. If you're hearing it, bring your vehicle to German Excellence in Winter Park for an inspection, catching it early can save you from a dead battery and a no-start down the road. | Do you replace the alternator and starter together? | Not necessarily, because the alternator and starter are two separate parts that fail independently. A bad alternator won't start your car reliably and a bad starter won't crank it, but a problem with one doesn't automatically mean the other needs replacing.
